Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Britannica result and incorrectly stated that Giovanni Gabrieli died in Vienna instead of Venice, then proceeded to tie the “Bridge of Sighs” to Vienna. The source actually indicates Venice as the place of death, so this misinterpretation led the reasoning down the wrong path.
